title: Van Goth wins Canada's Drag Race Season 6
summary: In the finale (CA-S06-E09), Van Goth and Eboni La'Belle lip-synced to Chappell Roan's "Super Graphic Ultra Modern Girl". Van Goth was crowned Canada's Next Drag Superstar; Eboni finished as runner-up. PM and Sami Landri were eliminated before the final lip sync. The season cash prize was $100,000 CAD.

title: Paolo Perfección: Season 6 Porkchop
summary: Paolo Perfección was the first contestant eliminated on Canada's Drag Race Season 6 (CA-S06-E02), lip-syncing to Trooper's "Raise a Little Hell" against Sami Landri after Hazel was saved from the bottom with the Golden Beaver.

title: Hazel named Miss Congeniality
summary: Hazel was voted Miss Congeniality by fellow contestants. She had been eliminated in CA-S06-E04 after lip-syncing to Avril Lavigne and Nicki Minaj's "Dumb Blonde" against PM.

title: Slayoffs double elimination
summary: In CA-S06-E06 ("Slayoffs"), Eboni La'Belle won the lip-sync slay-off extravaganza. After Van Goth was saved from the bottom with the Golden Beaver, Mya Foxx, PM, and Velma Jones lip-synced to Sarah McLachlan's "Sweet Surrender"; Mya Foxx and Velma Jones were both eliminated.

title: Van Goth's four maxi-challenge wins
summary: Van Goth won four maxi challenges across Canada's Drag Race Season 6: the Not Sorry Aboot It remix (CA-S06-E01), Pick Your Poison (CA-S06-E03, shared with Mya Foxx), Paris (Ontario) Fashion Week design (CA-S06-E07), and a CUNTest round (CA-S06-E08).
